name: @troupe/renderer
description: Troupe's local renderer: voices a script with Kokoro and composes the video with ffmpeg, optionally over an LTX-Video clip (HTTP contract v1); optionally transcribes sound for the studio's library.

scripts.setup:ltx: uv sync --project ltx && uv run --project ltx python ltx/generate.py --download
scripts.setup:whisper: uv sync --project whisper && uv run --project whisper python whisper/transcribe.py --download --model ${WHISPER_MODEL:-base}
